pages.title: Roll Your Dice
pages.body: Hold the rolling area to gather your dice, then release to roll. Every roll is unique!

pages.title: Match the Goal
pages.body: The Goal row at the top shows 8 target dice. When your roll matches a Goal die, it locks automatically.

pages.title: Unlock for More
pages.body: Drag a locked die down into the rolling area to unlock it. When the timer runs out, each one splits in two — a bonus die!

pages.title: Score Big
pages.body: Match all 8 Goal dice to win the round. Fewer dice in your pool means a higher score — up to 8 points!

pages.title: Stay Competitive
pages.body: After each round, winners start with fewer dice and losers get more. Every round is anyone's game!

pages.title: Race to 20
pages.body: First player to reach 20 points wins the session. Play smart — speed vs. efficiency is the core tension.
